blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A verified report from local barangay officials led to a successful anti-illegal drug operation early Sunday morning, September 20, resulting in the arrest of two suspected drug personalities. Authorities also confiscated ₱204,000 worth of suspected shabu during the operation. Operatives from the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Cebu Provincial Office and the Minglanilla Municipal Police Station carried out the buy-bust operation.
